assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson's hybrid oeuvre makes an unusually consequential formal contribution, bringing classical learning, lyric intensity, narrative experiment and visual thinking into mutually transformative relation.
assessment.attribution: The proposed citation can credit Carson alone for a body of writing that renews the possibilities of poetry, essay and dramatic form.
assessment.maturity: Representative works including Autobiography of Red and Nox indicate a sustained, varied project rather than a single formal breakthrough.
uncertainties: The comparative assessment depends partly on the supplied descriptions rather than comprehensive coverage of the corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pynchon's encyclopedic novels have made a singular contribution to postwar fiction through verbal invention, structural audacity and searching accounts of power, knowledge and technological modernity.
assessment.attribution: The contribution is attributable to Pynchon alone, with Gravity's Rainbow and Mason & Dixon offering a clear citation scope.
assessment.maturity: The named major novels support the view of a durable achievement across decades, though the unevenness of such ambitious work remains a comparative question.
uncertainties: This ranking cannot rest on complete re-evaluation of the full corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu's densely patterned writing appears to sustain an expansive imaginative project in which memory, embodiment and metaphysical inquiry are inseparable from prose form.
assessment.attribution: Blinding and Solenoid provide a coherent basis for crediting Cărtărescu's distinctive visionary fiction.
assessment.maturity: The description of a long project across fiction and poetry supports substantial artistic maturity.
uncertainties: Assessment of Romanian stylistic achievement is necessarily limited by translation and corpus-coverage uncertainty.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chamoiseau's work has enlarged the modern novel through creolized forms that make oral memory, collective history and linguistic plurality constitutive elements of narrative art.
assessment.attribution: Texaco and Slave Old Man clearly identify a single-author contribution to fiction and essayistic reflection.
assessment.maturity: The representative works suggest sustained development of a consequential literary method.
uncertainties: The force of French-Martinican Creole interplay and oral registers may be reduced in translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis is credited with a major remaking of modern Arabic lyric through myth, fragmentation and an exacting dialogue with inherited poetic resources.
assessment.attribution: Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses support a precise citation centered on poetic innovation.
assessment.maturity: The long poetic and essayistic career indicates exceptional continuity and influence of artistic purpose.
uncertainties: Arabic poetic form, allusion and sonic texture are difficult to assess fully through translation.
The supplied evidence gives limited coverage of the complete oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Wright's large polyphonic novels combine Indigenous sovereignty, oral-inflected narration and ecological time in an ambitious reimagining of what the novel can contain.
assessment.attribution: Carpentaria and The Swan Book establish a focused, writer-centered basis for credit.
assessment.maturity: The named work points to a developed and coherent literary vision across fiction and nonfiction.
uncertainties: The ranking depends on incomplete corpus coverage and cannot measure every dimension of the works' cultural and linguistic contexts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rivera Garza's experimental work challenges inherited distinctions among fiction, archive and testimony while confronting violence, authorship and erased lives.
assessment.attribution: No One Will See Me Cry and Liliana’s Invincible Summer delineate a distinctive contribution spanning inventive fiction and archival writing.
assessment.maturity: The cross-genre range suggests a mature project of formal and ethical inquiry.
uncertainties: Spanish-language stylistic nuance and the bilingual dimension cannot be fully evaluated here.
The supplied account offers limited evidence about the full body of work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Al-Koni's fiction is credited with creating a distinctive desert cosmology in which Tuareg experience, ecological constraint and metaphysical imagination achieve unusual imaginative scope.
assessment.attribution: Gold Dust and The Bleeding of the Stone support attribution to al-Koni of a coherent novelistic world and vision.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels indicate a sustained body of work with a recognizable literary territory.
uncertainties: Translation may obscure the linguistic and cultural specificity of Arabic prose and Tuareg reference.
This assessment lacks comprehensive coverage of the oeuvre.
